l-m-e1-b02-27.goal: Find and talk one rule from several examples of where di long hand dey point on di hour, then check di rule with new case.

l-m-e1-b02-27.s.s2.model.0: Di long hand dey point to 12 for 3, 7, and 10 o'clock sharp, so e dey point to 12 for 5 o'clock sharp too.
l-m-e1-b02-27.s.s2.model.1: Time dey on di hour when di long hand dey 12, so di long hand dey 12 no matter which hour e be.

l-m-e1-b03-11.goal: Find di rule and talk am from several examples of di sum of two identical numbers, then check di rule with one new case.

l-m-e1-b03-11.s.s1.r.c: Dis na di sum of 9+9. E go one step too far.

l-m-e1-b03-11.s.s2.model.1: Every time di number go up by 1, di sum go up by 2, so 8+8 na 16.

l-m-e1-b05-30.title: Conditions for choosing way to school
l-m-e1-b05-30.goal: When choosing way to school, balance clashing conditions, choose best compromise and explain why.
l-m-e1-b05-30.material: There are four routes to school. Route 1: 12 steps, 2 crossings. Route 2: 15 steps, 0 crossings. Route 3: 10 steps, 3 crossings. Route 4: 18 steps, 1 crossing. You want no more than 1 crossing and the shortest route.
l-m-e1-b05-30.s.s1.prompt: Choose route wey meet all the conditions.
l-m-e1-b05-30.s.s1.r.a: E cross road 2 times, so e no meet condition of at most 1.
l-m-e1-b05-30.s.s1.r.c: E cross 3 times, so e no meet the condition.
l-m-e1-b05-30.s.s1.r.d: E meet condition, but e longer than Route 2.
l-m-e1-b05-30.s.s1.explain: Routes with at most 1 crossing na Route 2 and Route 4. Route 2 shorter, so e fit.
l-m-e1-b05-30.s.s2.model.0: Among Route 2 and Route 4, both with at most 1 crossing, Route 2 get fewer steps, so e fit.
l-m-e1-b05-30.s.s2.model.1: Route 1 and 3 cross too many times. Route 4 longer than Route 2, so choose Route 2.
